when_to_use: Official causal mediation with one observed mediator; outcome/mediator continuous, binary, or count; binary, multivalued, or continuous treatment.
required_outputs: NIE; NDE; TE; optional PNIE/TNDE/POM/CDE/proportion mediated; effect scale transformations when appropriate
key_risks: Sequential ignorability, mediator-outcome confounding, treatment-induced confounder, unsupported FE/HDFE structure.

when_to_use: Official StataNow causal mediation with two parallel or sequential mediators when command support matches data.
required_checkpoint: C3a plus C6 if StataNow availability unclear
required_outputs: NIEs, NDEs, TE, path-specific or mediator-specific effects, CDE if relevant
key_risks: Stata version availability, mediator ordering, complexity of decompositions, support restrictions.

when_to_use: Linear path models, latent variables, multiple indicators, measurement models, direct/indirect path effects.
required_outputs: Path coefficients, direct/indirect/total effects, factor loadings, fit indices
key_risks: SEM fit does not identify causal mediation; misspecified measurement model; insufficient identification.

when_to_use: Generalized, nonlinear, multilevel, latent, or mixed-response path models.
required_outputs: Equation-specific coefficients, path effects via nlcom/simulation, marginal effects/predictions, convergence/fit diagnostics
key_risks: Scale dependence of indirect effects, convergence, random-effects assumptions, causal interpretation.

when_to_use: Panel/HDFE/DID/event-time mechanism evidence where official mediation commands cannot represent the identification strategy.
required_outputs: Total-effect model, mediator equation, outcome-with-mediator model, optional product/path effect, bootstrap CI
key_risks: Bad-control misuse, overclaiming causal mediation, inconsistent samples or FE across equations.
